ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (yellowish-white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous yellowish-white patches located on the distal halves of both lobes; separated by a central black vertical column and bordered by a thick black trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute angle of approximately 40 degrees converging at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge, increasing in jaggedness toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping curves on the leading edges, transitioning to a sharp convex flare at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters localized within the high-intensity patch of the left lobe; heavy heterogeneous clusters at both distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, roughly parallel light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment of the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation at both fluke tips; significant parallel linear rake marks on the left medial surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-cream tint across all high-intensity pigment regions.
